newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-STRONG FIELD FOR LOCH LOMOND EVENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-STRONG FIELD FOR LOCH LOMOND EVENT.

text.p: Nick Faldo, Tom Lehman and Steve Jones, winners of three of golf's four major titles in 1996, have all accepted invitations to play in the Loch Lomond World Invitational from July 9-12.
The event, which has been moved from its previous date in September, will be held in the week preceding the Open championship at Troon.

South African Ernie Els and last year's European number one, Colin Montgomerie, have also committed themselves to the Scottish event, in its second year. Faldo has described the lay-out as "the best, and best-conditioned course in Europe."
